chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, was asked about a muhrim who strikes game and then offers its expiation: should he eat it or discard it? He said:
"Then another expiation would be upon him."
It was said: "Then what should he do with it?" He said: "He should bury it."

key_terms.الصَّيْدَ: game animal hunted while in ihram
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of ihram during hajj or 'umrah
key_terms.فَيَفْدِيهِ: then he offers compensation or expiation for it

ai.seo_question: What should a muhrim do with hunted game after paying its expiation?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the muhrim who kills game and pays its prescribed fidyah. The Imam عليه السلام states that such game is not to be eaten, because doing so entails another expiation. Instead, it is to be buried.
